findings.title: 工具回合的过程分组丢失目标“再续”按钮回调
findings.aliasDisposition: Single promotion after independent92 and Root91 ordinary renderer/producer closure; not a second false-success item.
findings.validation: Static current production source only, independently reviewed; no product/helper/test/React/DOM/model/network/native execution.
findings.condition: Same unfinished user turn already contains a visible non-bookkeeping tool; ordinary approaching_limit goal marker remains, then a top-level model stream has busy=true and nonnull streamingAssistantId, so liveTurnActive=true and authoritative user turnTiming not completed.
findings.expected: The goal approaching marker retains its offered extension action while this normal goal/tool turn remains active, as flat renderer and emitter explicitly provide.
findings.actual: foldTurnProcess places the approaching marker in innerItems. MessageStream process-card branch does not pass onExtendGoal, and inner GoalProgressView has no onExtend. Leaf77 therefore omits its entire extend button region.
findings.impact: The intended extension action is absent from the approaching marker during the normal tool-bearing live model phase. No claim every frame, other Goal controls, actual truncation or measured occurrence.
counterevidence: No-tool turn renders flat with the callback.
Closed/non-live turn may expose trailing marker after lastTool; no claim every frame/all phases lose the action.
No approaching marker or intentionally callback-free historical contexts are not this trigger.
Other possible Goal controls are not certified or claimed unavailable.
findings.deduplication: Focused group-callback query0 of4693 current frozen history MD+recursive JSON scalar files; canonical112 catalogue has no item of this cause. Old July test-coverage gap mentions server extension failures/legacy routing, not this grouping callback. Existing B2 source comment concerns not_met pruning the marker, whereas this branch retains marker and omits callback. Limited search is not exhaustive semantic reading of all history.
findings.fixDirection: Thread the optional extension action through MessageStream process-card branch and TurnProcessGroupCard to the inner goal marker, retaining the existing flat path and callback-free contexts.
